title: Profile clock: unchanged alignment with the corner closed, open and after restart

steps.expect: Home with the first Dock app highlighted; the clock digits vertically centred inside the closed top-right capsule beside the profile picture
The top-right controls open on Settings; the clock sits left of the divider, vertically centred with the profile picture and controls
Inputs highlighted at the left edge of the top-right controls; the clock remains left of the divider without overlapping the controls
The profile picture highlighted at the right edge; the clock and divider stay aligned, with all three controls visible to their right
Home after restarting: the first Dock app highlighted, the clock vertically centred in the closed capsule beside the profile picture
After restarting, the top-right controls open on Settings; the clock remains centred to the left of the divider
